claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_size
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait's primary mechanic is a temporary self size increase to Large. The current surface has no effect atom for changing creature size without replacing the whole stat block or transforming into a different form.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.abilityFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current advantage atom can narrow ability checks by skill, but not by base ability. Large Form grants advantage on all Strength checks, which is broader than any closed skill subset and narrower than all ability checks.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks"
